request.purpose: Policy-making: planning hospital capacity and care pathways for the coming years.
request.question: For people aged 75 and above with chronic kidney disease, what is the average kidney function per hospital?
definitions: Very old patient = aged 75 or older on 31 December 2025.
CKD: ICD-10 codes beginning with N18.
Kidney function = the latest eGFR (LOINC 62238-1) of each patient; patients without one are left out.
Report per hospital: very old patients with CKD who have an eGFR and their mean eGFR, one decimal.
